name: Barcode Scanner
summary: Handheld pistol-grip barcode scanner with a red laser beam; use for shop checkouts and warehouse scanning.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the grip: the scanner stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the scanner is hero size, about 350 px tall with its beam about 500 px wide

params.name: anim
params.note: beam = laser flickers as if scanning
